Name: Boob Crops
Author: dracofreedom1976
Description:
Buy the Boob seeds from Pierre and grow from Spring to Fall. When fully grown harvest them to get cream fruit. Crop will regrow after harvest. I made this mod because i figured why not. And i thought it would be funny. This is my first mod.

Began some collaboration!

Place the CreamFruit into an oil maker to make large milk. Or if you get a giant crop version, place a tapper on it to produce milk daily!


Adds Sweetened Condensed Milk to the game by placing the Cream Fruit or Milk into a Dehydrator. 

Also adds one Recipe to the game - Sweet Cream Pie. It is loved by all the bachelor and bachelorettes and liked by the rest of the villagers.

Config Options:
{
             "SafeForWork": "true"
       }
This will cause the giant crops to wear a seasonal bikini top!
